entities.summary: Tania Maliarchuk (b. 1983-04-17, Ivano-Frankivsk) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ivano-Frankivsk and Ukraine. Known in the fields of ukraine, journalists & chroniclers, europe.
